answer: Attestation depth scoring at the web-of-trust: each identity's weight = log(depth of vouch chains), so sybils must build genuine links. Signal is the median vouch-depth of your neighbors, enforced statistically. The hollow cluster of 10k bought accounts collapses toward zero depth since real users won't attest them; farming depth past 5 costs ~50 honest attestations each, and the horizon of break-even never arrives. Depth-weighted trust makes sybil cost superlinear, so it works.
